newsitem.title: USA: Mass. says plans about $800 mln of bond sales.
newsitem.headline: Mass. says plans about $800 mln of bond sales.

text.p: Massachusetts plans to sell about $800 million of general obligation debt from November to June 1997, a state official said Monday.

Ken Olshansky, deputy state treasurer for debt and bonds, told a Bond Buyer New England public finance conference here that the state would issue about $200 of bonds in November, $200 million in February, $200 million in April and $210 million in June.
Proceeds from the bond sales will go to new money capital projects, he said.
Olshansky also said that the state's revenues are up and therefore a note borrowing has been postponed because there is no immediate need for short-term cash flow borrowing.
